synopsis: Lord McCrea of Magherafelt and Cookstown's full title is The Rev. Dr the Lord McCrea of Magherafelt and Cookstown. His name is Robert Thomas William McCrea, and he is a current member of the House of Lords.

history.heading: Military Bases: Security
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of the safety of military bases in the United Kingdom; and whether they are secure from attacks by Iran and Russia.

history.heading: Sanctions: Christianity
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what consideration they give to a country's treatment of its Christian population when deciding whether to apply sanctions.

history.heading: Northern Ireland Troubles Bill
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government, with reference to the Northern Ireland Troubles Bill, which person or body decides whether another investigation under the Bill is essential; what evidence must support that decision; and what independent oversight of this

history.heading: Northern Ireland Troubles Bill
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government, with reference to the Northern Ireland Troubles Bill, what assessment they have made of the merits of taking into account veterans' physical and mental health conditions when deciding whether to permit a prosecution referr

history.heading: Northern Ireland Troubles Bill
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government, with reference to the Northern Ireland Troubles Bill, what assessment have they made of the neutrality, independence and decision-making processes of the person or body permitting a prosecution referral.

history.heading: Public Inquiries: Costs
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what the costs are of the (1) Hamill Inquiry, and (2) Letby Inquiry.

history.heading: Vacancies
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what the total number of job losses has been since June 2024; how many job vacancies currently exist in the labour market; and whether the number of vacancies now is higher or lower than in July 2024.

history.heading: State Retirement Pensions: Taxation
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government whether they intend to tax state pensions.

history.heading: Inflation
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what measures they are taking to curb inflation and assist consumers.

history.heading: Mortgages: Government Assistance
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what plans they have to provide assistance to families under pressure due to rising bank mortgages.

history.heading: NHS: Antisemitism
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what measures they are taking against those within the NHS who subject patients, nurses, and doctors to anti-Jewish abuse.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Energy: Costs
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they are taking to increase energy security and lower energy costs; and what assessment they have made as to the potential impact of the conflict in the Middle East on domestic energy bills.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

history.heading: Dementia: Health Services
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government whether any key target been removed from the Modern Service Framework for Dementia and Frailty, due for publication later this year.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Agriculture: Finance
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they are taking to support (1) farmers in relation to increased costs deriving from the Iran war, and (2) the long-term financial sustainability of farm businesses.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

history.heading: National Security: Northern Ireland
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what is their most recent assessment of the security threat in Northern Ireland.

history.heading: Terrorism: Northern Ireland
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what recent discussions they have held concerning the replacement of the Northern Ireland Troubles (Legacy and Reconciliation) Act 2023, and with whom.

history.heading: UK Internal Trade: Northern Ireland
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what discussions they have held with representatives of the logistics industry on the cost of trade between Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

history.heading: Unemployment: Young People
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of youth unemployment trends in each region of the United Kingdom.

history.heading: Undocumented Migrants: France
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government how much they have paid to the government of France to stop illegal immigrants arriving from boats into the United Kingdom.

history.heading: China: Shipping
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what action they will take to stop Chinese research vessels in UK waters (1) intercepting cargo ships, and (2) charting the seabed for submarines.

history.heading: Defence: Northern Ireland
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of the potential impacts of the Defence Industrial Strategy 2025 on Northern Ireland.

history.heading: EU External Trade: Mercosur
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of any potential impacts of the EU-Mercosur trade agreement on farmers in Northern Ireland.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

history.heading: Accident and Emergency Departments: Death
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government how many patients have died waiting in A&E departments in England in the past 12 months; and how that figure compares with the figure for the period between June 2024 and June 2025.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Army: Northern Ireland
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they will take to protect the British Army from vexatious claims made by terrorists or their families relating to its actions during the Troubles.

history.heading: Heathrow Airport: Construction
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government when the third runway at Heathrow will commence construction.

history.heading: Civil Servants: Remote Working
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government whether any civil servants have been granted permission to work from a holiday destination abroad, and if so, how many; and which departments have approved this.

history.heading: Social Security Benefits: Finance
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what has been the increase in the welfare budget in the financial year 2025–26; and what is the estimated rise over the next financial year.

history.heading: Nigeria: Christianity
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what action they are taking to stop the continuing persecution and killing of Christians in Nigeria; and what representations they have made internationally on behalf of Christians enduring persecution.

history.heading: Public Sector Debt
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what is the UK’s national debt as a share of GDP; and how this compares with other G7 countries.

history.heading: Undocumented Migrants: France
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government how many migrants have been brought into the United Kingdom under the "one in, one out" agreement with France since the scheme began.

history.heading: Employment: Young People
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what measures they plan to take to help young people struggling to find work out of welfare dependency.

history.heading: Employment: Disability
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what progress they have made in improving access to work for people with disabilities.

history.heading: Retail Trade: Urban Areas
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what measures they are taking to support high streets.

history.heading: Women: Chronic Illnesses
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they propose to take to support women with long-term health conditions.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Abortion
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they intend to take to prevent any increase in the number of women performing dangerous late-term abortions at home.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: NHS: Strikes
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what is the estimated cost of strikes within the NHS in the past six months; and what new proposals are being considered to protect patient services during any further strikes.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Russia: G8
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of the re-entry of Russia into the G8; and what assessment they have made of whether Russia should pay compensation for the damage caused since its invasion of Ukraine.

history.heading: Maccabi Tel Aviv Football Club
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of whether the West Midlands Police relied on false intelligence when banning Maccabi Tel Aviv football fans from an Aston Villa match.

history.heading: Roads: Litter
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what measures they are considering to tackle littering on roads.

history.heading: Undocumented Migrants: Deportation
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what new measures they are proposing to effectively remove illegal immigrants as soon as they arrive in the UK

history.heading: Veterans: Northern Ireland
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what are the protective measures for veterans proposed in the Northern Ireland Troubles Bill to distinguish between veterans and those responsible for terrorist violence.

history.heading: India: Christianity
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what recent discussions they have had with the government of India concerning the recent denial of burial rights to Christian families in the state of Chhattisgarh.

history.heading: Undocumented Migrants: France
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what plans they have to respond to the refusal by France to take back migrants under the one-in-one-out scheme.
